indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX evidence_artifacts_pkey ON pipeline.evidence_artifacts USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX evidence_entity_idx ON pipeline.evidence_artifacts USING btree (entity_id, captured_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX evidence_source_idx ON pipeline.evidence_artifacts USING btree (source_id)
CREATE INDEX evidence_supersedes_idx ON pipeline.evidence_artifacts USING btree (supersedes_evidence_id)
CREATE INDEX pipeline_evidence_job_idx ON pipeline.evidence_artifacts USING btree (job_id) WHERE (job_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX evidence_artifacts_captured_idx ON pipeline.evidence_artifacts USING btree (captured_at DESC, id)
CREATE INDEX evidence_artifacts_type_captured_idx ON pipeline.evidence_artifacts USING btree (evidence_type, captured_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX evidence_artifacts_mime_captured_idx ON pipeline.evidence_artifacts USING btree (mime_type, captured_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX layer2_evidence_group_version_idx ON pipeline.evidence_artifacts USING btree (evidence_group_key, capture_version DESC) WHERE (evidence_group_key IS NOT NULL)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX layer2_evidence_group_capture_version_uq ON pipeline.evidence_artifacts USING btree (evidence_group_key, capture_version) WHERE ((evidence_group_key IS NOT NULL) AND (capture_version IS NOT NULL))

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX evidence_standard_group_hash_uq ON pipeline.evidence_artifacts USING btree (evidence_group_key, content_hash) WHERE ((retention_class = 'standard_365'::text) AND (evidence_group_key IS NOT NULL) AND (content_hash IS NOT NULL))
CREATE INDEX evidence_artifacts_source_hash_idx ON pipeline.evidence_artifacts USING btree (source_id, content_hash)
CREATE INDEX pipeline_evidence_activity_time_idx ON pipeline.evidence_artifacts USING btree (COALESCE(captured_at, created_at) DESC, id)
CREATE INDEX evidence_metadata_layer_captured_idx ON pipeline.evidence_artifacts USING btree (COALESCE((metadata ->> 'layer'::text), ''::text), captured_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX evidence_artifacts_storage_path_idx ON pipeline.evidence_artifacts USING btree (storage_path)
CREATE INDEX evidence_artifacts_captured_nulls_last_idx ON pipeline.evidence_artifacts USING btree (captured_at DESC NULLS LAST, id)
CREATE INDEX evidence_artifacts_created_at_idx ON pipeline.evidence_artifacts USING btree (created_at DESC)

CREATE INDEX evidence_artifacts_layer2_overview_coalesce_idx ON pipeline.evidence_artifacts USING btree (review_state, retention_class, captured_at DESC) WHERE (COALESCE((metadata ->> 'layer'::text), ''::text) = '2'::text)
CREATE INDEX evidence_artifacts_source_url_pattern_idx ON pipeline.evidence_artifacts USING btree (lower(source_url) text_pattern_ops)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sources_pkey ON pipeline.sources USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX pipeline_sources_provider_idx ON pipeline.sources USING btree (provider_id, status)
CREATE INDEX sources_country_idx ON pipeline.sources USING btree (country_id)
CREATE INDEX sources_system_idx ON pipeline.sources USING btree (system_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX pipeline_sources_scholarship_source_key_uidx ON pipeline.sources USING btree (((metadata ->> 'scholarship_source_key'::text))) WHERE (metadata ? 'scholarship_source_key'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX providers_pkey ON catalogue.providers USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX providers_stable_key_key ON catalogue.providers USING btree (stable_key)
CREATE INDEX providers_country_pub_idx ON catalogue.providers USING btree (country_id, publication_status)
CREATE INDEX providers_type_idx ON catalogue.providers USING btree (provider_type_id)
CREATE INDEX providers_subdivision_idx ON catalogue.providers USING btree (subdivision_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX courses_pkey ON catalogue.courses USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX courses_stable_key_key ON catalogue.courses USING btree (stable_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX courses_provider_code_version_idx ON catalogue.courses USING btree (provider_id, COALESCE(course_code, stable_key), COALESCE(source_version, ''::text))
CREATE INDEX courses_provider_pub_idx ON catalogue.courses USING btree (provider_id, publication_status)
CREATE INDEX courses_level_field_idx ON catalogue.courses USING btree (study_level_id, primary_field_id)
CREATE INDEX courses_primary_field_idx ON catalogue.courses USING btree (primary_field_id)
CREATE INDEX courses_course_code_upper_idx ON catalogue.courses USING btree (upper(course_code)) WHERE (course_code IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX courses_open_to_international_idx ON catalogue.courses USING btree (open_to_international)
CREATE INDEX courses_canonical_title_lower_id_idx ON catalogue.courses USING btree (lower(canonical_title), id)
CREATE INDEX courses_provider_with_url_idx ON catalogue.courses USING btree (provider_id, id) WHERE ((course_url IS NOT NULL) AND (course_url <> ''::text))
CREATE INDEX courses_not_active_idx ON catalogue.courses USING btree (id) WHERE (lifecycle_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'active'::text)
CREATE INDEX courses_provider_code_trim_active_idx ON catalogue.courses USING btree (provider_id, upper(btrim(course_code))) WHERE (lifecycle_status = 'active'::text)
